tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: In reported speech after a past reporting verb, tenses usually move back: is → was, are seeing → were seeing, saw / have seen → had seen, will → would, can → could. “We saw soldiers.” → He said (that) they had seen soldiers. Pronouns and time words change too: here → there, today → that day, tomorrow → the next day. Say + (that) clause; tell + person + (that) clause.

Pronouns and time words change too: here → there, today → that day, tomorrow → the next day. Say + (that) clause; tell + person + (that) clause.

end_good.title: Місію виконано!
end_good.text: Джессіка довго мовчить. «А що сказав доктор Юе?» — питає вона нарешті. Ти відповідаєш, що він сказав, ніби з усіма все гаразд. «Дивно, — шепоче вона. — Він ніколи не казав мені неправди». Вона йде, і її кроки звучать тривожно.
end_good.text_pl: Jessica długo milczy. „A co powiedział doktor Yueh?” — pyta wreszcie. Odpowiadasz, że powiedział, że wszyscy są zdrowi. „Dziwne — szepcze. — Nigdy mnie nie okłamał”. Odchodzi, a jej kroki brzmią niespokojnie.
end_good.text_en: Jessica is silent for a long time. “And what did Dr Yueh say?” she asks at last. You answer that he said everyone was fine. “Strange,” she whispers. “He has never lied to me.” She walks away, and her footsteps sound uneasy.
